item.title: Plan for controversial seabed mining operation off Taranaki coast abandoned
item.description: The company that has been trying to establish a seabed mining operation in the South Taranaki Bight since 2013 has withdrawn their application for a fast-track consent.

item.title: Promises to ban paywave surcharges 'going nowhere'
item.description: Promises to ban paywave surcharges to help consumers save money appear to have stalled.

item.title: The Government backed down on housing - could they back down on the gas levy too?
item.description: ACT Party leader David Seymour has said his party is “actively listening” and “open to the possibility” of another way of doing it

item.title: Watch: State highway in Rotorua filled with smoke as truck breaks down
item.description: Fire and Emergency NZ responded to a report of a truck and trailer engulfed in smoke oh SH30 just after 4pm.

item.title: Teacher’s partner sexually abused vulnerable student at couple’s home
item.description: The men, who were both teachers, have been formally censured and had their teaching registrations cancelled.

item.title: $720m, 2800-home lakefront development in Queenstown given green light
item.description: RCL Homestead Bay Limited lodged an application to fast-track its project in June 2025. On Thursday, Bishop announced the bid had been successful.

item.title: UK must not cede control of island hosting US military base, Trump says
item.description: The US President warned the UK Prime Minister that he was making a “big mistake” by entering into a 100-year lease with Mauritius.

item.title: Sinkhole forms near wastewater treatment plant on Coromandel Peninsula
item.description: Thames-Coromandel District Council has erected signage after a sinkhole formed near the wastewater plant, with treated wastewater suspected of entering wetland and stream.

item.title: Mum of climber who died on Austrian mountain says boyfriend ‘doesn’t deserve to be blamed’
item.description: Mother of 33-year-old who died metres from Austria’s highest summit backs partner ahead of manslaughter trial.

item.title: Chemical incident in Levin, 19 patients treated
item.description: The incident occurred on Hamaria Rd on Thursday at 6.30pm.
